title: Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts Will Be Resumed (2025-07-18)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will resume the funding rate settlement frequency of the following USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts to  every four hours  starting from  2025-07-18 16:00 (UTC) : RVNUSDT MASKUSDT LPTUSDT AXLUSDT VOXELUSDT LAYERUSDT  VICUSDT  FUNUSDT  WCTUSDT  HYPERUSDT  SIGNUSDT  SOPHUSDT  LAUSDT  SAHARAUSDT  FLMUSDT  NEWTUSDT HUSDT The detailed arrangement is as follows: Time Max Funding Rate 2025-07-18 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-18 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-19 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-19 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Please be noted that the max funding rate for MASKUSDT is 0.75% / -0.75%.  For More Information: Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates Important Updates on Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2025-05-02) Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-18
